title: Jagrav's No Pumpkin Blur
description: Removes the Pumpkin Blur, So you can see clearly.
body:
### What is Not Much Pumpkin Blur?
Not Much Pumpkin Blur removes the pumkin blur, which many players dislike. It helps you see in the end without aggroing endermans.
It helps you hide from the newly added locater bar in multiplayer servers. Which may help you if you want to hide from other players.
### Why would you want to download it?
Not Much Pumpkin Blur improves your quality of life by removing the pumpkin blur. Which helps you in various scenarios.
